notes.n8.framework: Open-source, developer-led; every frontier lab and hyperscaler now ships its own agent SDK (OpenAI, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK, AWS Strands, Microsoft Agent Framework) alongside independents LangChain (US$1.25B valuation, Oct 2025), LlamaIndex and CrewAI.
notes.n8.vector: Standalone vector DBs (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, Milvus/Zilliz, Chroma) compete with vector features in incumbent databases (Postgres/pgvector, MongoDB, Elastic, Redis, Oracle); retrieval models are being folded into search incumbents (Elastic-Jina, MongoDB-Voyage).
notes.n8.ingest: Two clusters: document parsing/OCR (Unstructured, Reducto, LlamaParse, Docling, Mistral OCR) and web-to-LLM search/crawl APIs (Tavily, Exa, Parallel, Firecrawl); the latter is consolidating into AI clouds (Nebius-Tavily ~US$275M, Feb 2026).
notes.n8.memory: Early, venture-funded and mostly open-source (Mem0, Letta, Zep, Cognee); hyperscalers now bundle managed memory (e.g. AWS AgentCore Memory) and vector-DB vendors are repositioning as memory layers.
notes.n8.tools: MCP became the de facto tool-integration standard and moved to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation (Dec 2025); value is shifting to auth-aware connector platforms (Composio, Arcade) and integration incumbents (Workday-Pipedream, Zapier, Workato).
notes.n8.sandbox: Two segments: code-execution sandboxes (E2B, Modal, Daytona, Vercel) and cloud browsers for web agents (Browserbase, Browser Use, Kernel); hyperscalers (AWS AgentCore, Cloudflare) now offer both natively.
notes.n8.platform: Dominated by data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake), hyperscaler agent platforms and application incumbents (Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP), with Palantir AIP as the leading independent; China served by Baidu, Alibaba and ByteDance clouds.
notes.n8.lowcode: Crowded: open-source builders (n8n at US$2.5B, Oct 2025; Dify; Flowise and Langflow now owned by Workday and IBM) vs. suite builders (Copilot Studio, OpenAI Agent Builder, Gemini Enterprise, Agentforce) and automation incumbents (Zapier, Make, UiPath, Workato).
notes.n8.payments: Protocol race in 2025-26: OpenAI/Stripe ACP (Sep 2025), Google AP2 (Sep 2025) and UCP (Jan 2026), Visa Trusted Agent Protocol, Mastercard Agent Pay and Coinbase/Cloudflare x402; agent identity is being absorbed by IAM incumbents (Okta, Microsoft Entra, Twilio-Stytch, PANW-CyberArk).
notes.n8.cache: Thin as a standalone market: semantic caching is mostly a feature of gateways and databases (Redis LangCache, Cloudflare, Portkey, GPTCache) and prompt optimisation is led by open-source DSPy.
notes.n8.eval: Heavy consolidation 2025-26: W&B to CoreWeave, Langfuse to ClickHouse, Helicone to Mintlify, Traceloop to ServiceNow, Galileo to Cisco, Humanloop team to Anthropic; Arize and Braintrust (US$800M, Feb 2026) remain the largest independents.
notes.n8.security: Fastest-consolidating sub-segment: in about 15 months, Palo Alto (Protect AI), Check Point (Lakera), SentinelOne (Prompt Security), F5 (CalypsoAI), Cato (Aim), CrowdStrike (Pangea), Zscaler (SPLX), Snyk (Invariant), Tenable (Apex), Proofpoint (Acuvity) and OpenAI (Promptfoo) bought startups; agent-security independents (Zenity, Noma, HiddenLayer) raised US$100M+ rounds.
notes.n8.gov: Pure-play AI governance vendors (Credo AI, Holistic AI, Saidot, Trustible) compete with GRC/privacy suites (OneTrust, Securiti-Veeam, Collibra) and platform-embedded governance (IBM watsonx.governance, ServiceNow AI Control Tower); demand is driven by EU AI Act and ISO 42001.
notes.n8.orch: Control-plane race among enterprise platforms (Microsoft Agent 365, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, IBM, AWS); open registries via MCP Registry and A2A Agent Cards.
notes.n8.search: Consolidating fast after Microsoft retired Bing Search APIs (Aug 2025): Nebius bought Tavily, Elastic bought Jina; Exa ($2.2B) and Parallel ($2B) lead independents.
notes.n8.identity: Incumbent IAM is buying in (Palo Alto-CyberArk, Cisco-Astrix, Twilio-Stytch) while Okta and Microsoft ship agent-native identity; Israeli NHI startups prominent.

entries.one_liner: Decentralised directory for publishing and discovering agents using the OASF schema.

entries.name: AI Verify
entries.access: Docker self-host toolkit; Moonshot for LLM testing
entries.one_liner: AI governance testing toolkit mapping technical tests to international principles.

entries.name: AP2 (Agent Payments Protocol)
entries.access: Implement via A2A/MCP extension and reference code
entries.one_liner: Protocol for agent-initiated payments using signed mandates for user authorisation.

entries.name: Arize Phoenix
entries.one_liner: Tracing and evaluation for LLM apps built on OpenTelemetry/OpenInference.
entries.note: Source-available ELv2, not OSI open source: bars offering it as a managed service.

entries.name: AutoGen
entries.one_liner: Pioneering multi-agent conversation framework, now in maintenance mode.
entries.note: In maintenance mode; Microsoft directs users to Microsoft Agent Framework.

entries.name: Browser Use (open)
entries.access: pip install browser-use; drives Chromium via Playwright/CDP
entries.one_liner: Library letting AI agents navigate and act in websites.

entries.name: Chroma (open)
entries.access: pip install chromadb; embedded or server
entries.one_liner: Developer-first embedding database for RAG; embedded or client-server.

entries.name: Cognee (open)
entries.one_liner: Memory engine building knowledge graphs plus vectors from data for agents.

entries.name: Crawl4AI (open)
entries.access: pip install crawl4ai; local async crawler
entries.one_liner: Open LLM-friendly web crawler and scraper producing Markdown and structured extractions.

entries.name: CrewAI (open)
entries.one_liner: Python framework for role-based multi-agent crews and event-driven flows.

entries.name: CycloneDX ML-BOM (ECMA-424)
entries.one_liner: Bill-of-materials standard covering ML models and datasets for AI supply-chain transparency.

entries.name: DeepEval
entries.one_liner: Pytest-style LLM evaluation framework with metrics for RAG, agents and safety.

entries.name: Dify (open)
entries.licence: Dify Open Source License (Apache-2.0 with additional conditions; source-available)
entries.access: Docker Compose self-host or Dify Cloud
entries.one_liner: Visual platform for building agentic workflows, RAG apps and chatbots.
entries.note: Extra conditions restrict multi-tenant SaaS use and require keeping branding; not OSI-approved.

entries.name: Docling
entries.access: pip install docling; convert PDFs/DOCX to Markdown/JSON
entries.one_liner: Document conversion with layout and table understanding, plus Granite-Docling VLM.
entries.note: Donated by IBM to LF AI & Data Foundation in 2025.

entries.name: DSPy (open)
entries.one_liner: Declarative framework that programs LMs and automatically optimises prompts and weights.

entries.name: E2B (open)
entries.access: SDK to hosted sandboxes; infra repo self-hostable
entries.one_liner: Firecracker-based secure cloud sandboxes for running AI-generated code.

entries.name: EU GPAI Code of Practice
entries.one_liner: Voluntary code on transparency, copyright, safety for general-purpose AI under the EU AI Act.

entries.name: FAISS
entries.one_liner: Library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.

entries.name: Firecracker
entries.access: Run microVMs on Linux KVM hosts
entries.one_liner: Lightweight microVM monitor used by many agent code-execution sandboxes.

entries.name: Firecrawl (open)
entries.access: Self-host with Docker or use hosted API
entries.one_liner: Crawls, scrapes and searches the web returning LLM-ready Markdown or structured JSON.
entries.note: Core is AGPL-3.0: network use triggers source-sharing obligations; hosted API is commercial.

entries.name: Flowise (open)
entries.one_liner: Drag-and-drop builder for LLM flows and agents; now end-of-life.
entries.note: Wound down: code freeze 29 Jul 2026, repo archived 10 Aug 2026, EOL 31 Aug 2026; forks encouraged.

entries.name: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK)
entries.one_liner: Code-first toolkit for building, evaluating and deploying agents; A2A-native.

entries.name: GPTCache
entries.one_liner: Semantic cache for LLM responses using embeddings and vector stores; activity has slowed.

entries.name: Granite Guardian
entries.access: Download from Hugging Face; run as risk classifier
entries.one_liner: IBM risk-detection models for harm, jailbreak, RAG groundedness and function-call hallucination.

entries.name: Graphiti
entries.one_liner: Temporally-aware knowledge-graph engine for agent memory; core of Zep.
entries.note: Zep Community Edition deprecated in 2025; Graphiti remains the open-source piece.

entries.name: Guardrails AI (open)
entries.access: pip install guardrails-ai; validators from Guardrails Hub
entries.one_liner: Framework of input/output validators for structured, safe LLM outputs.

entries.name: gVisor
entries.one_liner: Application kernel sandbox isolating containers; used for untrusted agent code execution.

entries.name: Haystack
entries.one_liner: Pipeline framework for production RAG, search and agent applications.

entries.name: Jina Reader
entries.access: Prefix URL with r.jina.ai or self-host
entries.one_liner: Converts any URL to LLM-friendly Markdown; s.jina.ai adds web search.

entries.name: kagent
entries.one_liner: Kubernetes-native framework for running and managing AI agents and MCP tools.

entries.name: LanceDB (open)
entries.access: pip install lancedb; embedded, files on object storage
entries.one_liner: Embedded multimodal vector database on the Lance columnar format.

entries.name: LangChain
entries.one_liner: Framework and integration library for LLM apps and agents; v1 built on LangGraph.

entries.name: Langflow (open)
entries.one_liner: Visual builder for agents and RAG flows, deployable as APIs or MCP servers.

entries.name: Langfuse (open)
entries.one_liner: Open LLM engineering platform: tracing, prompt management, evals, datasets.

entries.name: LangGraph
entries.one_liner: Low-level graph-based orchestration for stateful, durable, human-in-the-loop agents.

entries.name: Letta (open)
entries.access: pip install letta or Docker server
entries.one_liner: Stateful agent platform with self-editing tiered memory, from the MemGPT research.

entries.name: LlamaIndex (open)
entries.one_liner: Framework for RAG and document agents over private data, with workflows.

entries.name: LLM Guard
entries.steward: Protect AI (acquired by Palo Alto Networks 2025)
entries.access: pip install llm-guard; repo now read-only
entries.one_liner: Input/output scanners for prompt injection, PII, toxicity and secrets.

entries.name: Marker
entries.licence: Code Apache-2.0; model weights modified AI Pubs OpenRAIL-M (paid above $5M revenue/funding)
entries.one_liner: Fast PDF/EPUB/Office-to-Markdown converter built on Surya OCR and layout models.
entries.note: Weights free for research and startups under $5M; commercial licence needed above that.

entries.name: MarkItDown
entries.access: pip install markitdown; CLI or MCP server
entries.one_liner: Converts Office files, PDFs, images and more to LLM-friendly Markdown.

entries.name: Mastra (open)
entries.licence: Apache-2.0 core; ee/ directories under Mastra Enterprise License
entries.one_liner: TypeScript agent framework with workflows, memory, RAG, evals and MCP.

entries.name: MCP reference servers
entries.access: Run via npx/uvx from any MCP client
entries.one_liner: Reference MCP servers (filesystem, git, fetch, memory) and pointers to community servers.

entries.name: MCP Registry
entries.access: Query public registry API or self-host sub-registry
entries.one_liner: Official metaregistry of publicly available MCP servers that downstream registries sync from.

entries.name: Mem0 (open)
entries.access: pip install mem0ai; self-host or Mem0 platform
entries.one_liner: Universal memory layer extracting and retrieving user/agent memories to cut context tokens.

entries.name: Microsoft Agent Framework
entries.one_liner: Successor unifying AutoGen and Semantic Kernel for building and orchestrating agents.
entries.note: Announced Oct 2025 as successor to AutoGen and Semantic Kernel.

entries.name: Milvus
entries.one_liner: Distributed cloud-native vector database for billion-scale similarity search.

entries.name: MinerU
entries.licence: MinerU Open Source License (Apache-2.0 base with additional conditions)
entries.access: pip install mineru; CLI or API
entries.one_liner: PDF-to-Markdown/JSON extraction with layout, formula and table recognition.
entries.note: Moved from AGPL-3.0 to a custom Apache-based licence with extra conditions; check terms.

entries.name: MITRE ATLAS
entries.access: Browse atlas.mitre.org; use with ATT&CK tooling
entries.one_liner: Knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques against AI-enabled systems.

entries.name: MLflow (GenAI)
entries.access: pip install mlflow; self-host tracking server
entries.one_liner: ML lifecycle platform with GenAI tracing, evaluation and prompt registry.

entries.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
entries.steward: Agentic AI Foundation (Linux Foundation); created by Anthropic
entries.access: Implement with official SDKs (Python, TS, Java, C#, Go, more)
entries.one_liner: Open protocol connecting LLM apps to tools, data and prompts; spec includes OAuth-based authorization.
entries.note: Donated by Anthropic to Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation, Dec 2025.

entries.name: MTEB (Massive Text Embedding Benchmark)
entries.access: pip install mteb; leaderboard on Hugging Face
entries.one_liner: Benchmark and leaderboard for text-embedding models across retrieval, clustering and classification tasks.

entries.name: n8n (open)
entries.licence: Sustainable Use License (fair-code, source-available) + n8n Enterprise License
entries.access: Self-host via npm/Docker for internal use; n8n Cloud
entries.one_liner: Workflow automation with AI agent nodes and 400+ integrations.
entries.note: NOT OSI open source: restricts commercial resale/hosting; enterprise features separately licensed.

entries.name: NeMo Guardrails
entries.access: pip install nemoguardrails; define rails in Colang
entries.one_liner: Programmable input, output, dialog and retrieval rails for LLM applications.

entries.name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
entries.one_liner: Voluntary framework (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage) for AI risk, with GenAI profile.

entries.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
entries.one_liner: Lightweight provider-agnostic agent SDK with handoffs, guardrails, tracing.

entries.name: OpenHands
entries.access: Docker run or pip; local or cloud runtime
entries.one_liner: Open coding-agent platform with sandboxed Docker runtime, SDK and CLI.

entries.name: OpenInference
entries.one_liner: OTel-compatible instrumentation and conventions for LLM and agent tracing.

entries.name: Opik
entries.one_liner: Tracing, evaluation and optimisation platform for LLM apps and agents.

entries.name: OSWorld
entries.one_liner: Benchmark of real computer-use tasks across operating systems and apps.

entries.name: OWASP Top 10 for LLM and GenAI Applications
entries.one_liner: Community list of top LLM application risks, e.g. prompt injection, excessive agency.

entries.name: Perplexica
entries.access: Docker self-host with SearXNG and local or API models
entries.one_liner: Open answer engine that searches the web and cites sources.

entries.name: pgvector (open)
entries.access: CREATE EXTENSION vector in Postgres; on all major clouds
entries.one_liner: Postgres extension adding vector types and HNSW/IVFFlat indexes.

entries.name: Playwright
entries.one_liner: Cross-browser automation framework underpinning most agent browser tooling.

entries.name: Playwright MCP
entries.access: npx @playwright/mcp; add to any MCP client
entries.one_liner: MCP server giving agents browser control via Playwright accessibility snapshots.

entries.name: PurpleLlama (Prompt Guard, LlamaFirewall, CodeShield, CyberSecEval)
entries.licence: Mixed: MIT (evals, CodeShield); Llama Community Licences (Guard models)
entries.one_liner: Meta's open trust-and-safety toolkit: guard models, agent firewall, insecure-code filter, cyber evals.

entries.name: Pydantic AI (open)
entries.one_liner: Type-safe Python agent framework from the Pydantic team, model-agnostic, with durable execution.

entries.name: Qdrant (open)
entries.access: Docker run or Qdrant Cloud free tier
entries.one_liner: Rust vector search engine with filtering, hybrid search and quantisation.

entries.name: Qwen3Guard
entries.one_liner: Multilingual safety moderation models, including streaming token-level classification.

entries.name: Ragas
entries.one_liner: Evaluation toolkit for RAG and agent pipelines with LLM-judged metrics.

entries.name: SearXNG
entries.access: Docker self-host; JSON API for agents
entries.one_liner: Self-hosted privacy metasearch engine commonly used as agents' search backend.

entries.name: smolagents
entries.one_liner: Minimal library for code-writing agents that act by generating Python.

entries.name: SPIFFE / SPIRE
entries.access: Deploy SPIRE server/agents; issue SVIDs to workloads and agents
entries.one_liner: Workload identity standard and runtime, increasingly used to identify AI agents.

entries.name: Strands Agents
entries.one_liner: Model-driven agent SDK from AWS, used in Amazon Q and Bedrock AgentCore.

entries.name: TextGrad
entries.one_liner: Automatic 'differentiation' via text feedback to optimise prompts and outputs.

entries.name: Trusted Agent Protocol
entries.access: Reference implementation for merchants and agent developers
entries.one_liner: Lets merchants verify trusted AI agents and their intent at checkout via signed requests.

entries.name: Unstructured (open source)
entries.access: pip install unstructured; partition PDFs, Office, HTML
entries.one_liner: Partitions and chunks dozens of document types into clean elements for LLM pipelines.

entries.name: Vercel AI SDK
entries.one_liner: TypeScript toolkit for building AI apps and agents across model providers.

entries.name: Vespa
entries.one_liner: Search and ranking engine combining vectors, text, structured data and ML ranking.

entries.name: Weaviate (open)
entries.one_liner: Vector database with hybrid search, built-in vectorisers and multi-tenancy.

entries.name: Web Bot Auth (IETF)
entries.access: Sign HTTP requests with HTTP Message Signatures
entries.one_liner: Emerging standard for bots and agents to cryptographically identify themselves to websites.
entries.note: Started as Cloudflare-authored drafts (2025); IETF working group formed to standardise it.

entries.name: x402
entries.access: Add middleware to HTTP server; pay with stablecoins
entries.one_liner: HTTP 402-based payment standard letting agents pay per request in stablecoins.
entries.note: Moved from coinbase/x402 to x402 Foundation org.
